Strategy: Reward leftovers between twenty and thirty, a lower mid-size band than the winning twenty-eight to forty-two window. It may help if slightly smaller leftovers are more useful, but may fail by favoring bins that leave too little room.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if r - item >= 20 and r - item <= 30 else 0) for r in bins]
```
